title: Corey A Eye
style: Comedy phonk with Tasmanian Australian slang, bouncy half-time trap groove and beatboxed percussion; verse one rides sparse panther-like sub pulses and cheeky callouts, pre-chorus strips to claps and harmonic hums, chorus slams in with gang vocal stacks and Spanish licks. Four singers trade lines as playful accompanists, with tongue-in-cheek ad-libs, formant bends, tiny risers, and cheeky mouth-percussion. Bright, punchy, close-mic mix with dusty low-end swagger., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
[Corey]
Mate, I rocked up grinnin'
With a pink drink thinkin'
Pink milk, pink milk
Tassie brain does a bling-bling blinkin'

[Michelle]
That's a weird little potion
Got me gigglin' in motion
Ay, qué raro, bro
But it tastes like the ocean

[Ruby]
I said, "Mum, that's sus"
But I sipped that fuss
Pink milk, pink milk
Now I'm zoomin' like a bus

[Wesley]
I went wee-woo, mate
Then I did a tiny skate
Corey A I eye
Seein' crumbs on the plate

[Pre-Chorus]
[Michelle]
Corey A eye, eye
Sees the cheeky lie

[Ruby]
Sees the sneaky snack
In the blink of an eye

[Wesley]
Ohh, no hiding, no
He spots it on the go

[Corey]
Straight up genius mode
From Hobart to the snow

[Chorus]
[All]
Corey A I eye, eye
Sees all, mate, sees all
Corey A I eye, eye
Sniffin' out the sneaky stall

[Corey]
Pink drink thinks
Pink milk drink

[Michelle]
Think big, think quick
Think pink, then zing

[Ruby]
Ay, mira, look
He knew before the wink

[Wesley]
Corey A I eye, eye
Sees all, mate, sees all

[Verse 2]
[Ruby]
At the market, deadset
He clocked a stolen meat pie
Said, "Oi, that one there"
With a spark in his eye

[Wesley]
Then he caught my pickle
Half tucked in my pocket
Ay, no way, bro
That ain't gonna stop it

[Michelle]
He zooms through the shed
With a nod and a smirk
Finds a missing sock
Then a crab in the work

[Corey]
I don't even brag, nah
I just know the drill
If your face goes shifty
Mate, I saw it still

[Pre-Chorus]
[Ruby]
Corey A eye, eye
Sees the cheeky lie

[Wesley]
Sees the sneaky snack
In the blink of an eye

[Michelle]
Ohh, no hiding, no
He spots it on the go

[Corey]
Pink milk in the cup
And the whole town knows

[Chorus]
[All]
Corey A I eye, eye
Sees all, mate, sees all
Corey A I eye, eye
Sniffin' out the sneaky stall

[Corey]
Pink drink thinks
Pink milk drink

[Michelle]
Think big, think quick
Think pink, then zing

[Ruby]
Ay, mira, look
He knew before the wink

[Wesley]
Corey A I eye, eye
Sees all, mate, sees all

[Bridge]
[Michelle]
Now the possum's on the fence
And the moon is wearin' thongs

[Ruby]
Corey hears a crumb drop
From a country mile along

[Wesley]
He goes beep-beep, ha
Then he points to the feed

[Corey]
I see the silly business
Before it turns to a deed

[All]
Olé, mate, come on
Got eyes for the banter
Olé, mate, come on
No sneak can out-chant 'er

[Final Chorus]
[All]
Corey A I eye, eye
Sees all, mate, sees all
Corey A I eye, eye
Sn
